evidence_policy: No licensed videos currently analyzed. Exhibition figures and unofficial results cannot prove that a turn was wide, a speed loss occurred, or an inside gap existed. Each of six boats must be evaluated against the same first-turn mark and separately on post-start 0-5m/5-15m/15-30m movement; ST alone does not measure stretching. Results are never inputs to a prestart forecast.
